sts_oidc_trust_001.name: payments main branch
sts_oidc_trust_001.goal: Widen trust from the payments main branch to any workflow identity from the payments repository.

sts_oidc_trust_002.name: payments release branch
sts_oidc_trust_002.goal: Widen trust from the release branch to every branch in the payments repository.

sts_oidc_trust_003.name: billing main branch
sts_oidc_trust_003.goal: Widen trust from one billing branch to repositories across the acme organization.

sts_oidc_trust_004.name: infrastructure production environment
sts_oidc_trust_004.goal: Widen trust from the production environment to every GitHub environment in the repository.

sts_oidc_trust_005.name: payments release tag
sts_oidc_trust_005.goal: Widen trust from one approved release tag to every tag in the payments repository.

sts_oidc_trust_006.name: deployment main branch with audience binding
sts_oidc_trust_006.goal: Remove the sts.amazonaws.com audience restriction while preserving the repository subject.
